name: cursor2discord
description: Discord Rich Presence for Cursor — shows what you're editing, what Cursor AI is doing, and when Claude Code is running.
//extensionKind: The Discord IPC socket lives on the local machine, so this must run on the UI host — omitting this breaks Remote-SSH and devcontainers entirely.

commands.title: Rich Presence: Set Up Claude Code Details

cursor2discord.applicationId.description: Override the Discord application ID, which controls the name and icon shown after "Playing". Leave blank to use the bundled default. Icons are served from a URL and never need uploading, so a custom ID needs no further setup.

cursor2discord.showElapsedTime.description: Show elapsed time on the presence.

cursor2discord.elapsedTimeResetsOnFileCh.description: Reset the elapsed timer whenever you switch files, instead of counting the whole session.

cursor2discord.idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds of inactivity before switching to the idle presence. 0 disables idle detection.

cursor2discord.detectClaudeCode.description: Watch the integrated terminal for Claude Code sessions and surface them in the presence. Requires shell integration.

cursor2discord.claudeCodeCommands.description: Command names that count as a Claude Code session.

cursor2discord.claudeCode.liveActivity.markdownDescription: Show what Claude Code is actually doing — current tool, file, session title, tokens — when the `cursor2discord` Claude Code plugin is installed. Without the plugin this has no effect and the presence falls back to a plain "Claude Code" state.

cursor2discord.claudeCode.showTokens.description: Include token counts and context usage on the card and in the icon hover text. Requires the token tier (/cursor2discord:enable-tokens).

cursor2discord.detectCursorAi.description: Surface Cursor AI activity (Composer / Chat / inline edits) in the presence.

cursor2discord.priority.description: Which activity wins when several are active at once, highest first.

cursor2discord.privacy.mode.markdownDescription:
How much to reveal.
- `full`: file names, workspace, git branch
- `hideFileNames`: language only
- `hideWorkspace`: file names but no workspace/repo
- `minimal`: just "Working in Cursor"

cursor2discord.privacy.ignoredWorkspaces.description: Glob patterns for workspace paths where presence is suppressed entirely.

cursor2discord.privacy.ignoredFiles.description: Glob patterns for files whose names are never shown.

cursor2discord.templates.claudeCode.deta.markdownDescription: Line 1 during a Claude Code session. Extra variables: `{claudeActivity}` (e.g. `editing client.ts`), `{tool}` `{verb}` `{target}` `{model}` `{sessionTitle}` `{tokensIn}` `{tokensOut}` `{contextPercent}` `{tokenSummary}` `{claudeUptime}`. All require the Claude Code plugin and collapse away without it. `{cursorUptime}` always resolves.

cursor2discord.templates.claudeCode.stat.markdownDescription: Line 2 during a Claude Code session. `{tokenSummary}` renders `72.0K in / 199 out · 7% ctx` and needs the token tier; `{cursorUptime}` and `{claudeUptime}` render `3h 12m`. Unresolved parts collapse their separators. Falls back to the editing line when the whole line resolves to nothing.

cursor2discord.buttons.markdownDescription: Up to two buttons. `url` supports `{repoUrl}`, which is dropped if the workspace has no remote.

cursor2discord.statusBar.enabled.description: Show a status bar item with the connection state.

scripts.publish:ovsx: npm run package && ovsx publish cursor2discord-$npm_package_version.vsix
